displayName: Flatmate API: near its instance limit

documentation.content: flatmate-api has run at 80% or more of its max instances for 10 minutes (the threshold assumes the launch max of 30: update it with `API_MAX_INSTANCES`). Past the max, Cloud Run queues and then refuses requests. Before raising the max, check that instances x (DB_POOL_SIZE + DB_MAX_OVERFLOW) still fits the database pooler's client limit (docs/CAPACITY_PLAN.md).
